policy_framework: Ministry of Power Guidelines dated 17 September 2024 (Ref No. 12/2/2018-EV)

urban_evaluation.policy_title: Guidelines and Standards for Installation and Operation of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure - 2024
urban_evaluation.issuing_authority: Ministry of Power, Government of India
urban_evaluation.standard_clause: Clause 11(1)(a) — Urban 1km x 1km Grid Density Target (by FY 2029-30)
urban_evaluation.mandate: At least 1 charging station within a 1 km x 1 km grid in urban areas by FY 2029-30 (FY 2030)
urban_evaluation.compliance_verdict: PARTIALLY COMPLIANT — URBAN EXPANSION REQUIRED TO MEET FY2030 TARGET

expressway_evaluation.policy_title: Guidelines and Standards for Installation and Operation of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure - 2024
expressway_evaluation.standard_clause: Clause 11(1)(b), Clause 11(1)(c) & Clause 12(7) — Highway Spacing & Heavy-Duty Norms
expressway_evaluation.highway_spacing_standard: Clause 11(1)(b): At least one charging station every 20 km on both sides of highways and expressways
expressway_evaluation.heavy_duty_standard: Clause 11(1)(c) read with Clause 12(7): At least one fast-charging station every 100 km on each side, equipped with at least two chargers of minimum 240 kW each
expressway_evaluation.compliance_verdict: PARTIALLY COMPLIANT — 20KM SPACING GAPS IN CENTRAL CORRIDOR (WASHIM/BULDHANA); 0% COMPLIANT ON 240KW HEAVY-DUTY CHARGERS

statutory_note: Evaluations strictly reflect verified public datasets. Proximity does not assume dual carriageway access.
